children: The 5% jump in U.S. crude oil prices today is having some of the familiar effects we've seen in recent months across the market when tensions build in the Middle East.

Winners largely are coming from the energy sector, which is the best performing group in the S&P 500 today. BP, Shell and ConocoPhillips are all up 2% or more, with ExxonMobil, Occidental, Chevron, Marathon and Phillips 66 all up at least 1%.

Travel stocks that are hurt by higher fuel prices are moving the other way, led by United Airlines and Norwegian Cruise Line, both down 3% or more. JetBlue and American Airlines are down 2% or more, with more modest declines for Delta Air Lines, Royal Caribbean, Carnival and Southwest.
